'''Nam''', also known as '''Chorios II''', was a [[Color/Legends|violet-white]] [[Star/Legends|star]], located within the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
